risk_note: RV2 by path (payment). Admin pay order reads and needs_manual resolve (BR-PAY-05 / 07 / 08): GET /admin/v1/pay-orders, /pay-orders/{id}, /pay-anomalies (pay.view, no channel-side payer identifiers in answers, logs or audit) and POST /admin/v1/pay-orders/{id}/resolve (pay.resolve + step-up TOTP): only a PENDING needs_manual order, one channel query, then under the business-object lock the existing pay-query / pay-close judgement (PAID -> PO2 with PAY_RECEIPT and opening; closed / not-exist -> PO3; otherwise nothing moves), audit with the query response as evidence. Per D10-357 markPaid (PO2) and markClosed (PO3) clear needs_manual in the same CAS on all four paths (resolve, notification, query, close). The four operations leave planned; the frozen CT-21e contract tests were split by #1624 and only block C tightened (red_exempt for the 19 unchanged tests, #1626). No migration; no amount rule change.
